calls.statement:
WITH weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS weekly_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON fsw.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND ds.store_id < 900
    AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_week
)
SELECT AVG(weekly_value) AS average_closing_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly_totals

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_week,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS weekly_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON fsw.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND ds.store_id < 900
  AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
GROUP BY d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  fsw.store_key,
  fsw.product_key,
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON fsw.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND ds.store_id < 900
  AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
GROUP BY fsw.store_key, fsw.product_key, fsw.week_ending_date
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 10
